request.text: Make it look like a children's storybook.

source.timing_basis: decoder frame index and reported FPS; sampled observations, not a continuous-motion verification

v1.prompt: Reimagine this entire video as a warm, hand-painted children's picture book illustration brought gently to life. Render both people and the room with soft watercolor washes, opaque gouache accents, delicate colored-pencil outlines, and visible cream paper grain. Give the characters charming, simplified expressive faces and softly rounded illustrated forms. Keep the young man's wavy sandy hair and pale blue striped shirt, and the woman's long dark hair and white jacket. Preserve the original composition and natural movements: he sits at the round table writing in the little spiral notebook, while she points at the page and rests her other hand on his shoulder. Keep the pen, notebook, loose paper, and background plants recognizable, interpreting them with the same handmade storybook treatment. Use a harmonious pastel palette of cornflower blue, warm peach, ivory, and sage green, with gentle painted shadows and an inviting, quiet mood. Make every frame clearly illustrated rather than photographic, with consistent character designs and stable paper texture throughout the motion. Keep the original camera framing and timing. No added text, captions, borders, or new objects.

outcome.summary: The edit convincingly reads as a children's storybook across the five-second clip. Character and hand shapes remain coherent, and the writing and pointing gestures are preserved. Visible differences are minor; no major defect clearly warrants another generation.

findings.claim: Pastel washes, paper grain, drawn outlines, rosy cheeks, and irregular white page edges form a cohesive storybook illustration throughout.

The illustrated face, hair, hands, tool, and notebook remain coherent without an obvious abrupt deformation or final-frame pop. The opening close-up also shows distinct pointing, writing, and page-holding hands.
findings.scope: whole frame; additional opening hand/paper crop

findings.claim: Small writing-hand movements remain visible with the tool directed toward the notebook; the woman's extended finger continues pointing at the page. The original interaction stays readable despite the pen becoming a pencil and the notebook being redrawn.
The writer's page-holding hand gains dark nail coloring absent from the source.
findings.partial_boundary: The hand remains recognizable and anatomically readable; its nail coloring changes.

findings.claim: The candidate's page is much fainter and nearly blank compared with the source. Even in the opening close-up, fresh marks and exact stroke-by-stroke correspondence cannot be verified.

gains: A cohesive illustrated world replaces the photographic treatment, with soft color, textured paper, and expressive character drawing.
regressions: Page markings lose visibility, notebook geometry is reinterpreted, and the writer's resting hand gains dark nails.
retained: Two-person composition, downward attention, shoulder contact, writing gesture, and pointing toward the notebook.
unknowns: Exact writing strokes and newly deposited marks.

strengths: Convincing storybook treatment across characters, clothing, props, and background.
Stable character and hand shapes with readable interaction.
unresolved: Fine writing traces remain unverified; this visibility limit does not establish failure of the broader writing action.

final.message: Applied a warm watercolor storybook look with soft pastels, paper texture, and illustrated characters while preserving the writing and pointing interaction.
